% Pattern: theorem/newenvironment/article. An environment with no title that
% steps the item counter and sets its body bold writes numbered headings.
% A use whose body leads with a group of a known title, as {Example}, is an
% item of that kind. A use with another title is a heading, not an item, but
% it steps the counter.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want nonsec-1 example 1.3
% want nonsec-2 statement/proposition 1.4
% want lem-2 statement/lemma 1.5
\documentclass{article}
\newcounter{item}
\renewcommand{\theitem}{\arabic{section}.\arabic{item}}
\renewcommand{\theequation}{\thesection.\arabic{equation}}
\newenvironment{lem}{
\setcounter{item}{\value{equation}} \addtocounter{equation}{1}
\refstepcounter{item}
\par {\bf \theitem.\hspace{1em}Lemma.} \sl }
{\par}
\newenvironment{nonsec}{\bf
\setcounter{item}{\value{equation}}\addtocounter{equation}{1}
\refstepcounter{item}
\par \theitem.\hspace{1em}\ignorespaces }
{\unskip .\ \ \ }
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{lem} Each tree is a graph. \end{lem}
\begin{nonsec}{Trees}\end{nonsec}
\begin{nonsec} {Example} \label{ex} \end{nonsec}
A path is a tree.
\begin{nonsec} {Proposition} \end{nonsec}
Each star is a tree.
\begin{lem} Each forest is a graph. \end{lem}
\end{document}
